description: S5 home AI server: scripts-only package (no dependencies). Short names for the docker compose / git commands the buttons page also runs, so bring-up, clean-up, and rebuilds stop being lengthy shell commands. Requires docker compose and git on PATH, plus node/npm only as the script runner.
name: remote-server

scripts.browser-relay:recreate: docker exec remote-buttons-1 docker compose -f /home/ari/remote-server/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps browser-relay
scripts.caddy:reload: docker cp ./caddy/Caddyfile remote-caddy-1:/tmp/Caddyfile.new && docker exec remote-caddy-1 caddy reload --config /tmp/Caddyfile.new --adapter caddyfile
scripts.code-server:recreate: docker exec remote-buttons-1 docker compose -f /home/ari/remote-server/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps code-server
scripts.lint:python: ruff check --select F,E4,E7,E9 backend deep-agent tests scripts && python3 scripts/verify-python-paths.py
scripts.lint: bash -n scripts/*.sh && (command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 && shellcheck -S warning scripts/*.sh || true) && npm run compile-check && npm run lint:python && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.terminal:build: docker exec remote-buttons-1 docker compose -f /home/ari/remote-server/docker-compose.yml build terminal
scripts.update:buttons: git pull --ff-only && docker compose up -d --build buttons
